# Molecule Master

> Molecule Master is a free, browser-based chemistry learning game in English. Players build molecules and explore chemical bonds, ions, reactions, intermolecular forces, molar mass, orbitals, and all 118 elements.

## Application
- Canonical URL: https://moleculemaster.eu/
- Type: interactive educational web application; the learning modules are sections on the homepage, not separate URL routes.
- Audience: learners exploring introductory chemistry concepts.
- The game is a learning aid, not a laboratory procedure or a substitute for authoritative chemical data.

## Chemistry References
- IUPAC Gold Book: https://goldbook.iupac.org/ (chemistry terminology and definitions)
- PubChem: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ (substance and molecular data)
- NIST Chemistry WebBook: https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/ (thermochemical and spectral data for selected substances)
